mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.acceptance_id AS acceptanceId, a.acceptance_no AS acceptanceNo, a.purchase_id AS purchaseId, a.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, a.acceptance_date AS acceptanceDate, a.acceptance_by AS acceptanceBy, a.acceptance_status AS acceptanceStatus, a.total_amount AS totalAmount, a.remark, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_time AS createTime FROM spd_acceptance a WHERE a.acceptance_id = #{acceptanceId} AND a.del_flag = #{delFlag}
